name: show-me
description: Explain the current topic visually with the smallest view that makes the point: pseudocode, a call tree, a component or file tree, a Mermaid diagram, a diff of the shape that changes, or one focused HTML page. Use when you want to see the topic instead of reading about it. Manual only: run it with /show-me. Ported from HumanLayer.
